summary: Frontend-only verification of More Works homepage section, hero-less Work page, and cursor-follow 3D tilt interaction. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: No issues. Slugify happens in both MoreWorks.jsx and Work.jsx; could be centralised in mock.js when projects are exported, but current implementation is correct.
TiltCard inline transform is set via style.transform directly (imperative) — acceptable for perf but bypasses React state; documented behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage now has: Hero -> IntroReveal -> RecentProjects (featured Burger Hot) -> MoreWorks (button top-right + 2x2 grid of odera/yaloo/woodland-publishing/burrowed). /work has no hero/title, tilt-grid with 6 cards. TiltCard sets inline style.transform on .tilt-media via onMouseMove (perspective(900px) rotateX rotateY scale(1.03)) and resets on mouseleave. Verified via playwright page.mouse.move.
verified_flows: Homepage: more-works-button present in top-right (btnRight=0), 4 tilt-cards (odera,yaloo,woodland-publishing,burrowed), burger-hot correctly excluded from grid.
Click More Works button -> navigates to /work.
/work: no 'Our Work' text, no hero, .work-page-min + .tilt-grid render 6 cards (all slugs). grid-template-columns=636px 636px (2 col).

Tilt interaction on burger-hot .tilt-media: transform=''  before mousemove, 'perspective(900px) rotateX(-1.71deg) rotateY(2.58deg) scale(1.03)' during, 'perspective(900px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) scale(1)' after leave. border-radius=20px confirmed.
Click tilt-card-odera on /work -> /work/odera renders 'Odera' case study.
Navbar shows 'Work' link after scroll; Footer renders; no console errors on homepage or /work.
